title: Formosa Network
description: Formosa Network - #1 Taiwanese modern PVP Server
body:
![logo](https://formosa.network/logo-long.png) 戰鬥練習、FFA、自由沙盒，一個伺服器涵蓋**高版本 PvP**的主要型態
Practice, FFA, SandBox. A All-in-One High Version PVP Server that Includes Everything! ## 玩法介紹 / Game Modes ### Practice 競技導向的對戰練習場。提供 MCTier 標準項目之排位匹配，並設娛樂模式與派對模式供非競技性對局使用。 A practice ground built for competition. Offers ranked matchmaking across MCTier-standard categories, with casual and party modes for non-competitive play. ![Practice](https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbjN1a2VzbXQ2MDM0MzF3cjRsdWZpOTcwNndncnh0ajIxbnFibTNybiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/KruWBAbvX43wsh3ekv/giphy.gif) ### FFA 開放式自由對戰。設有兩種場地 — 超平坦地形之鑽石王牌 FFA、以及多地形之盾斧 FFA，並內建自行開發之公會系統。 Open-format free-for-all combat. Two arenas — Superflat Diamond-tier and multi-terrain Shield-and-Axe — paired with an in-house guild system. ![FFA](https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYWhodGRyZnd5eXF2dGp1eTFlNXBlaXQ0bTdqc3lzcHdxdDNuaXZkdiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/PAI9QJHab7RdkJHBTl/giphy.gif) ### 平地大亂鬥 FlatLandBrawl 開闊平面地形之多人混戰。捨去地形變數，專注於近距離對抗與高頻交戰。 Multiplayer combat on open flat terrain. Strips out terrain variables to focus on close-range engagement and high-frequency fights. ![FlatLandBrawl](https://formosa.network/sections/flatlandbrawl/default.png) ### Sandbox 自訂 Kit 原版 PvP 環境。涵蓋水晶 PvP、重錘 PvP、SMP 等項目，提供多種地形供玩家選擇。 A custom-kit vanilla PvP environment. Covers Crystal, Mace, and SMP formats, with multiple terrains available. ![sandbox](https://formosa.network/sections/sandbox/default.png) ## 更多資訊 Other Info 🔗 來加入戰鬥吧～ Play with us Now!!!!!
